profile.headline: Engineer, Artist, Tree Hugger
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with a deeply nerdy love of troubleshooting and a knack for developing efficient procedures. 10+ years experience in software development. Strong propensity for deep diving in order to gain understanding of systems or solve the most complex challenges. Passionate about Linux, clean lines, and the planet.  
Serves on Board of Directors at Sepo Zambia, a non-profit benefiting the people of Western Zambia. https://sepozambia.org/about/board/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer on the Tricentis SeaLights Agent Engineering Team.  My work spans bug fixes, feature design and implementation, writing clean, well-documented code, and developing efficient, automat-able AI-assisted dev workflows. I also design and build AI agent tooling aimed at making the SeaLights platform more accessible to internal and external customers.

positions.title: Senior Professional Services Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead enterprise customers through complex agent-based integrations across CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Azure DevOps, GitLab), reducing onboarding time and accelerating adoption of SaaS tooling.
- Architect and deploy scalable solutions on bare-metal, Docker/Docker Compose, and Kubernetes, ensuring high availability and repeatable deployments in heterogeneous infrastructure environments.
- Integrate applications across multi-language ecosystems (Java, Python, Go, JavaScript) and testing frameworks (pytest, JUnit, Cucumber, Jest, Mocha, Selenium), enabling seamless quality coverage across polyglot microservices.
- Build and maintain containerized reference architectures in Go, Python, Java, and JavaScript, serving as demo environments, customer certification platforms, and internal troubleshooting assets that shorten resolution time by 40%.
- Diagnose and resolve critical integration challenges by reproducing customer environments, providing configuration fixes, and delivering actionable bug reports to engineering, driving faster release cycles and improved product stability.
- Design reusable Postman Collections and workflows with pre-configured environments and sample requests, enabling customers to automate coverage reporting and reduce manual setup effort by 60%.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and support teams to deliver customer-focused solutions that increase platform adoption, retention, and expansion within enterprise accounts.

positions.title: Senior Technical Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
I specialize in DevOps and Infrastructure support at the Enterprise-level, assisting customers with implementation and maintenance of Mend's suite of integrated application security tools. I am also passionate about developer enablement and support, particularly for developers using Mend's SCM integrations. 

I provide Technical Solutions to Mend's biggest clients, who use a variety of Mend AppSec solutions (Github, GHE, Gitlab, CI/CD, CN), deployed on both Mend-hosted (PaaS, SaaS) and customer-hosted basis. My role can be summarized in three categories:

1. Tactical (Reactive) Solutions, e.g.
	- Complex technical investigations - identify root cause, design/deploy solution, provide RCA
	- Developer support (e.g. Open Office hours and working sessions, enablement for customer's "Mend Champions", etc)

2. Strategic (Proactive) Solutions, e.g.
	- Identify customer needs/pain points and make recommendation for:
		-- A. Refinements/improvements to their deployment (architecture, resource allocation, migration, upgrades), processes around, or implementation of Mend solutions
		-- B. The relevant Mend product/feature/tooling
	- Coordinate with Mend Product teams to enhance or develop a product/feature 
	- Coordinate with Mend engineering to improve functionality/logging/efficiency or identify/address bugs
	- Research, plan, and communicate recommendations for 
		- Expansion of customer's adoption of Mend products/features
		- Upgrade or migration of Mend integration deployments

3. Execution/Management of Technical Initiatives
	- Support customer's rollouts of new Mend deployment, implementation, or feature to their users
	- Provide (internal and external) customers with technical guidance and instruction around Mend solution architecture and functionality, developer workflows and tooling, and general troubleshooting methodology
	- Mentor junior engineers via weekly working sessions; maintain a lab (AWS) for the purpose of ongoing education and testing

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
I specialize in DevOps and Infrastructure support for Enterprise-level customers, assisting them with implementation, upgrades, and maintenance of Mend's suite of integrated developer tools.
--------
Mend, formerly known as WhiteSource, is an application security company built to secure today’s digital world. We want developers to do what they do best: build the applications that power the world. Our job is to keep those apps safe.

positions.title: Founder and President
positions.description: Linux SysAdmin, web developer, graphic designer. In love with containerization, Bootstrap (especially @latest), and clean lines. I'm on a mission to protect the planet.

positions.title: GPRS Data Services/Network Operations
positions.description:
Responsibilities and experience include:  
-Unix and Linux systems administration
-GPRS cut-over project planning/management 
-Creation/utilization of MOP (Method of Procedure) documents 
-Technical diagramming and mapping for use in project planning and implementation, training and support  
-Creation of documentation, used in training and support for data staff, business sales staff, and customer support representatives on a variety of topics related to GPRS services 
-Design and implementation of testing procedures used in approval of GPRS/GSM data services 
-Collaboration with vendors in testing and implementation of updates and new technologies to GPRS data core 
-Deployment and support of multi-site IPSEC VPN solutions  
-Design, deployment and support of multi-site eBGP over GRE solution 
-Monitoring multiple GPRS and ISP data services, using Cacti,Nagios, Zabbix, Intermapper 
-Research and development for BlackBerry and Android devices. 
-Administration over BlackBerry Enterprise servers 
-Administration of GPRS Data Core routers and DNS servers (Cisco, Juniper) 
-Administration and maintenance of over-the-air update platform  
-Implementation and maintenance of multiple web-based tools used by sales and service staff to simplify the various procedural tasks  
-Email server administration (Exim4, dovecot, qpopper, vm-pop3d) 
-Corporate firewall administration and maintenance (Fortigate, Netscreen/Juniper)  
-Presentation of technical solutions to technical and non-technical staff and customers

positions.title: Tier 2 Tech Support
positions.description:
Responsibilities and experience include:

-acceptance and resolution of wireless trouble tickets
-troubleshooting wireless data and voice troubles
-creation of technical troubleshooting guides for sales/service channels
-implementation of intranet KnowledgeBase, designed to integrate with existing trouble ticketing system

positions.title: Senior Sales Representative
positions.description:
Responsibilities and experience include: 

-Retail sales of wireless services and devices, as well as sales of residential services. 
-In-store customer service and technical support of wireless services.
-Earned reputation for problem solving, with Retail and Care channels, as well as with internal and external customers.
-Responsible for co-handling Black Berry warranty and repair claims, with a replacement rate of less than 5%.
-Created and implemented Black Berry troubleshooting guide and warranty form for Retail 
channel.
-Created troubleshooting guides for several different handsets and potential network troubles.
-Continually deferred several trouble tickets from being sent unnecessarily by providing answers and troubleshooting guidance to Care and Retail channels.
